title: Enter the race — Dragon's Back Race entry tiers, included services and entrant GPX
claims: The entry page lists a GPX file of the route and checkpoint locations made available in advance to registered entrants.
The entry includes five nights of tented accommodation at overnight camps, a participant marquee, volunteers and an info point, Dragon Mail message service and shared charging stations at camps.
The entry includes a bespoke waterproof annotated Harvey map plus a digital version, GPS tracking, digital timing, daily support-point access to the resupply dry bag, and a manned daily water point.

The organisers transport participants' overnight dry bags to each overnight camp and resupply dry bags to each daily support point; onward transport from the support point is provided if a runner retires.

Camp catering includes breakfast, finishing snacks and dinner each day, unlimited tea/coffee/hot and cold water, and a celebratory meal on the last night; medical professionals and a mountain rescue response team are available.

2026 entry pricing was tiered by booking time: Super Early £1,899 with £99 deposit until 31 August, Early Bird £1,999 with £199 deposit through September, Standard £2,099 with £299 deposit from October; a non-refundable deposit is followed by £150/month instalments.

There is no separate qualifying race on the entry page: participants simply accept the participant declaration on entry; terms and conditions and the deferral/options article must be read before entering.
